title: Article 48A — Protection and improvement of environment and safeguarding of forests and wild life

content.overview: Article 48A directs the State to endeavour to protect and improve the environment and to safeguard the forests and wild life of the country.
content.glance: State to protect and improve the environment and safeguard forests and wild life.
content.study:
Article 48A (42nd Amendment) is the environmental DPSP. Read with Article 51A(g) (fundamental duty) and expanded Article 21 jurisprudence, it supports environmental legislation and judicial protection of ecology.

Examination: environment; forests; wild life; link Art 51A(g) and Art 21.

sections.heading: Key directive
sections.body: Protect and improve the environment; safeguard forests and wild life.

questionsAndAnswers.question: What does Article 48A provide?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Article 48A directs the State to endeavour to protect and improve the environment and to safeguard the forests and wild life of the country.
